title: Antiseizure medication interactions
scopeNotes: Selected interactions relevant to stroke and inpatient care — not a complete interaction checker

entries.title: Carbamazepine or phenytoin with apixaban or rivaroxaban
mechanism: Combined P-gp and strong CYP3A4 induction
management: Avoid the combination (both labels name carbamazepine and phenytoin)
pearls: Fosphenytoin is a phenytoin prodrug — same interaction
sources: Eliquis (apixaban) US prescribing information. Bristol-Myers Squibb; revised 6/2026 (user-supplied label)
Xarelto (rivaroxaban) US prescribing information. Janssen; revised 3/2026 (user-supplied label)

entries.title: Enzyme-inducing antiseizure medications with warfarin
management: Monitor INR closely when starting, stopping or changing the dose of the inducer
sources: Warfarin sodium tablets US prescribing information (RemedyRepack); revised 10/2026 (user-supplied label)

entries.title: Carbapenems with valproate
effect: Clinically significant ↓ valproate level → loss of seizure control
management: Monitor valproate levels frequently after starting a carbapenem
If levels drop significantly or seizures worsen, change the antibiotic or the antiseizure medication
Imipenem label: generally not recommended — raising the valproate dose may not be enough; prefer a non-carbapenem; if imipenem is necessary, consider supplemental ASM therapy (Primaxin §5.3, §7.3)
sources: Valproic acid oral solution US prescribing information. Atlantic Biologicals; revised 5/2024 (user-supplied label)
Primaxin (imipenem and cilastatin) for injection US prescribing information. Merck Sharp & Dohme; revised 7/2024 (user-supplied label)

entries.title: Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole with phenytoin
management: Avoid (Beers 2023, adults ≥65)
sources: 2023 American Geriatrics Society Beers Criteria Update Expert Panel. American Geriatrics Society 2023 updated AGS Beers Criteria for potentially inappropriate medication use in older adults. J Am Geriatr Soc 2023;71:2052-2081. doi:10.1111/jgs.18372

entries.title: Gabapentin or pregabalin with opioids
effect: ↑ severe sedation-related adverse events, including respiratory depression and death
management: Avoid, except when transitioning from opioids to a gabapentinoid or using a gabapentinoid to reduce opioid dose — then use caution
sources: 2023 American Geriatrics Society Beers Criteria Update Expert Panel. American Geriatrics Society 2023 updated AGS Beers Criteria for potentially inappropriate medication use in older adults. J Am Geriatr Soc 2023;71:2052-2081. doi:10.1111/jgs.18372

entries.title: Three or more CNS-active drugs including antiseizure medications
effect: ↑ falls and fractures with ≥3 CNS-active drugs
management: Avoid ≥3 together; minimize the number of CNS-active drugs
sources: 2023 American Geriatrics Society Beers Criteria Update Expert Panel. American Geriatrics Society 2023 updated AGS Beers Criteria for potentially inappropriate medication use in older adults. J Am Geriatr Soc 2023;71:2052-2081. doi:10.1111/jgs.18372

entries.title: Enzyme-inducing antiseizure medications with tacrolimus or cyclosporine
management: Tacrolimus: increase the dose and monitor whole-blood troughs (Prograf Table 15)
Cyclosporine: adjust the dose to target levels (Neoral Drug Interactions)
Carbamazepine label: monitor tacrolimus levels and adjust (Tegretol)
pearls: Oxcarbazepine is named in the cyclosporine label only
Fosphenytoin is a phenytoin prodrug — same interaction
Carbamazepine and phenytoin labels also list cyclosporine as lowered (Tegretol; Dilantin Table 3)
sources: Prograf (tacrolimus) capsules, injection, granules US prescribing information. Astellas; revised 8/2023 (user-supplied label)
Neoral (cyclosporine) capsules and oral solution (modified) US prescribing information. Novartis; revised 8/2026 (user-supplied label)
Tegretol (carbamazepine) tablets, suspension, XR tablets US prescribing information. Novartis; revised 8/2026 (user-supplied label)
Dilantin (extended phenytoin sodium capsules) US prescribing information. Viatris; revised 8/2023 (user-supplied label)

entries.title: Macrolides, azoles or isoniazid with carbamazepine
management: Monitor carbamazepine levels closely; dose adjustment may be required (Tegretol)
Isoniazid: check a carbamazepine level before starting; watch for toxicity and adjust (isoniazid label)
pearls: Voriconazole with carbamazepine is contraindicated — carbamazepine lowers voriconazole (voriconazole §4); see the voriconazole entry
Tegretol label also lists ciprofloxacin, diltiazem, verapamil, fluoxetine, omeprazole, aprepitant, protease inhibitors, grapefruit juice
sources: Tegretol (carbamazepine) tablets, suspension, XR tablets US prescribing information. Novartis; revised 8/2026 (user-supplied label)
Fluconazole tablets USP US prescribing information. ANI; revised 8/2025 (user-supplied label)
Isoniazid tablets USP US prescribing information. Marlex; revised 9/2025 (user-supplied label)
Voriconazole tablets US prescribing information. Aurobindo; revised 4/2026 (user-supplied label)

entries.title: Fluconazole or voriconazole with phenytoin
effect: Fluconazole 200 mg/day: phenytoin AUC +88% (range 16–247%) in volunteers; nonlinear kinetics make the size unpredictable (fluconazole label)
management: Monitor phenytoin levels closely (both labels)
Voriconazole: also monitor frequently for phenytoin adverse effects (Table 11)
Voriconazole maintenance must be increased with phenytoin: 4 → 5 mg/kg IV q12h, or 200 → 400 mg PO q12h (100 → 200 mg if <40 kg) (voriconazole §2.7, Table 10)
pearls: Phenytoin impairs efficacy of fluconazole, ketoconazole, itraconazole, posaconazole and voriconazole (Dilantin Table 3)
Fosphenytoin is a phenytoin prodrug — same interaction
sources: Dilantin (extended phenytoin sodium capsules) US prescribing information. Viatris; revised 8/2023 (user-supplied label)
Fluconazole tablets USP US prescribing information. ANI; revised 8/2025 (user-supplied label)
Voriconazole tablets US prescribing information. Aurobindo; revised 4/2026 (user-supplied label)

entries.title: Carbamazepine or phenytoin with dabigatran or edoxaban
mechanism: Dabigatran and edoxaban are P-gp substrates; P-gp inducers lower exposure (Pradaxa §5.5; Savaysa §12.3)
management: Carbamazepine: avoid with dabigatran or edoxaban (Tegretol names both)
Phenytoin: lowers dabigatran and edoxaban levels (Dilantin Table 3); Pradaxa: P-gp inducers should generally be avoided (§5.5); Savaysa: avoid rifampin (§7.2) — neither names phenytoin
pearls: Fosphenytoin is a phenytoin prodrug — same interaction
sources: Tegretol (carbamazepine) tablets, suspension, XR tablets US prescribing information. Novartis; revised 8/2026 (user-supplied label)
Dilantin (extended phenytoin sodium capsules) US prescribing information. Viatris; revised 8/2023 (user-supplied label)
Pradaxa (dabigatran etexilate) capsules US prescribing information. Boehringer Ingelheim; revised 6/2025 (user-supplied label)
Savaysa (edoxaban) tablets US prescribing information. Daiichi Sankyo; revised 7/2025 (user-supplied label)

entries.title: Lacosamide with drugs that affect cardiac conduction
precipitantDrugs: sodium channel blockers (including sodium channel-blocking ASMs)
effect: Further PR prolongation; AV block, bradycardia, ventricular tachyarrhythmia — rarely asystole, cardiac arrest, death (§5.3)
management: ECG before starting and after titration to steady state (§5.3, §7.2)
Monitor closely if given IV (§7.2)
pearls: Also caution with marked 1st-degree AV block, 2nd-degree or higher AV block, sick sinus without pacemaker, severe cardiac disease, Brugada (§5.3)
Profound bradycardia (26 bpm) during a 15-min 150 mg IV infusion in a patient on a beta-blocker (§6.1)
sources: Vimpat (lacosamide) tablets, injection, oral solution US prescribing information. UCB; revised 5/2026 (user-supplied label)

entries.title: Carbamazepine or long-acting barbiturates with voriconazole
effect: ↓ voriconazole levels (likely significant) → loss of antifungal efficacy
management: Contraindicated (voriconazole §4)
pearls: Phenytoin is not contraindicated — increase the voriconazole dose; see the fluconazole/voriconazole–phenytoin entry
sources: Voriconazole tablets US prescribing information. Aurobindo; revised 4/2026 (user-supplied label)
